I went to school a little, but most of what I do still comes from what has worked on my land and what I have seen around me. This plot is very small and it is my own land, so I will not leave it empty-handed, but I also will not spend too much cash on it because a small plot can swallow money quickly. I will use manure first, then a small amount of chemical fertilizer if I can get it through the cooperative, and I will manage it mostly with family labor.
